relationships.name: Negative keywords (Search and Shopping campaigns)
relationships.difference: The packet documents PMax negative keywords only for Search and Shopping inventory within a Performance Max campaign and says nothing about negative keywords in standard campaigns, so the shared name does not establish equivalence.
relationships.context: Advertisers carrying negative-keyword practice from Search campaigns into Performance Max; identical behavior beyond the documented Search and Shopping scope cannot be assumed from this evidence.

relationships.name: Negative keywords applied to all campaigns
relationships.difference: Applies the exclusion across all campaigns instead of a single Performance Max campaign; the packet notes the option but documents neither its steps nor its inventory scope.
relationships.context: Choosing between per-campaign and all-campaign query exclusion when setting up Performance Max negative keywords.
